scripts.build:android: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode android && cap sync android
scripts.build:ios: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode ios && cap sync ios
scripts.check:security: pnpm build && node scripts/security-check.mjs && pnpm audit
scripts.check:compat: pnpm build && playwright test --config playwright.compat.config.ts && node scripts/check-real-epubs.mjs
scripts.check:preferences: pnpm build && playwright test --config playwright.preferences.config.ts && node scripts/check-preferences.mjs
scripts.check:long-chapters: pnpm build && playwright test --config playwright.long-chapters.config.ts && node scripts/check-long-chapters.mjs
scripts.check:performance-browser: pnpm build && playwright test --config playwright.performance.config.ts && node scripts/check-performance-browser.mjs
scripts.check:sharing: pnpm build && playwright test --config playwright.sharing.config.ts && node scripts/check-sharing.mjs
scripts.check:pwa: pnpm build && node scripts/pwa-check.mjs && node scripts/bundle-size.mjs
scripts.check:interactions: pnpm build && playwright test --config playwright.interactions.config.ts && node scripts/check-interactions.mjs
